Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join activities to assays, target dictionary, molecule dictionary, and compound structures. Filter for target CHEMBL1075104, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
